channel.title: mint - markets
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Nvidia earnings, Anthropic IPO, Federal Reserve minutes, retail sales - Top things to watch
item.description: Nvidia's earnings announcement on Tuesday will be among the biggest events of the week, as investors look for indications that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong amid concerns over the sustainability of massive investments in the sector

item.title: Watrana Rentals IPO GMP profit calculator on latest GMP: How much profit can retail and HNI investors expect?
item.description: Watrana Rentals’ ₹120.10 crore SME IPO will open on November 19 and close on November 23. The fresh issue comprises 49.02 lakh shares, with a price band of ₹232–245 and a lot size of 600 shares. The IPO is expected to list on NSE SME on November 27.

item.title: Multibagger small cap stock delivers 91% return in 1 year! IDBI Capital sees 17% upside - Do you own? Check target price
item.description: Rolex Rings shares have gained 91% over the past year. IDBI Capital maintained a Buy rating and set a target price of ₹241, citing the company’s growth prospects from the Make in India ecosystem, rising capacity utilisation and strong quarterly results.

item.title: 144% return in 6 months: Multibagger to turn 1 stock into 18 after split, bonus- Do you own it? Check ratio, return
item.description: SC Agrotech shares have surged, gaining 144% in six months and 266% in a year. The company has proposed a 1:10 stock split and a 4:5 bonus issue, which would turn each existing share into 18 shares. The record date for both actions is yet to be announced.

item.title: Stock to buy after Q2 Results 2026: Up 70% in YTD! Should you buy retail stock after strong guidance? Target, stop-loss
item.description: Baazar Style Retail shares rose 5.39% on Friday and gained about 20% in a week ahead of the company’s Q2 FY27 results. Revenue from operations declined year over year to ₹47,848.31 lakh.&nbsp;

item.title: Crystal Crop Protection IPO one lot profit calculator on latest GMP: How much can retail and HNI investors earn? Listing
item.description: Crystal Crop Protection’s ₹455.49 crore IPO opens November 18 and closes November 20, with shares priced at ₹259– ₹272. The latest grey market premium of ₹14 suggests a potential listing price of ₹286, or a 5.15% gain at the upper price band.

item.title: Gold, silver prices ahead of wedding season: Down over 4% this week - Investors guide before US Fed Dec meeting
item.description: Gold and silver futures recovered slightly on Friday but posted steep weekly losses as hotter US inflation, a stronger dollar and rising bond yields heightened expectations of a Fed rate hike. Analysts see near-term pressure, while Indian wedding demand and central-bank buying may cushion gold.

item.title: Stock market outlook, November 16-20: Nifty logs 3-week winning streak, first since June - Rally ahead or a pause?
item.description: Indian equities may extend their rally during November 16–20, though volatility is expected. Strong foreign inflows, earnings and bullish technical momentum support the outlook, while crude prices, the rupee, geopolitical tensions and US policy signals pose risks.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty cheer as Bulls, FPIs back in Indian stock market; pump in over ₹84k cr in Nov so far - More rally ahead?
item.description: FPIs invested ₹84,291 crore in Indian equities in November, helping the Sensex and Nifty extend their recovery and drawing buying into broader markets. Analysts cite earnings growth, reasonable valuations and global portfolio shifts as drivers.

item.title: Sebi to issue AI guidelines for capital markets soon, focus on investor protection and human oversight
item.description: The regulator plans safeguards on AI disclosures, accountability and decision-making; cybersecurity framework also under review

item.title: PSU dividend this week Nov 16-20: Cochin Shipyard, Power Finance Corp, SCI to Oil India - Check record dates and returns
item.description: Four PSU stocks will attract attention this week as investors track dividend record dates: Cochin Shipyard and Shipping Corporation of India on November 16, Power Finance Corporation on November 17, and Oil India on November 20. Their announced dividends range from ₹3 to ₹7 per share.

item.title: Coal India's Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Stage set for launch, price band tomorrow; GMP, allotment, listing, other details
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields, Coal India’s largest coal-producing subsidiary, will open its IPO for subscription from 19 to 23 November. The offer is a sale of up to 66.18 crore shares by Coal India, expected to raise about ₹9,500 crore. The price band is yet to be announced.

item.title: Nifty 50 above 25,000, holds key moving averages: Is Buy-On-Dips right strategy? Here's what stock market experts say
item.description: Indian markets fell on Friday after retail inflation rose to 6.09%, above the RBI’s tolerance limit, but analysts said the broader technical outlook remains positive. They cited support around 24,850–24,900 and recommended buying on dips if key levels hold.

item.title: Powerful solar stock to generate further returns? 33% up in 6 months, Motilal Oswal sees 40% more; do you own it? Target
item.description: Fujiyama Power Systems shares fell 2.05% on Friday, extending recent losses, though they remain up 33% over six months. Motilal Oswal expects earnings growth in the second half of FY27, citing expanding distribution, new facilities and strong rooftop solar demand.&nbsp;

item.title: ABB India shares 36% up in 2026: Time to buy? Rating upgrade boost and target price hike by Motilal Oswal - Details here
item.description: ABB India reported an 11% rise in September-quarter profit to ₹440 crore and a 19.4% rise in revenue to ₹3,738 crore. Record order inflows rose 56% to ₹4,733 crore. Motilal Oswal upgraded the stock to Buy and set a target of ₹8,200, citing growth prospects and improving margins.

item.title: Tata Motors shares: 22% down in 2026, right time to buy famous auto stock? What brokerages say after loss narrows in Q2
item.description: Tata Motors PV reported a Q2 FY27 consolidated loss of ₹5,531 cr, including exceptional charges of ₹6,738 cr, even as revenue rose 34% and EBITDA margin improved. Brokerages are divided: Motilal Oswal maintained Sell with a ₹240 target, while Nuvama retained Buy with a revised ₹360 target.

item.title: Kamarajar Port picks SBI Capital, IDBI Capital and ICICI Securities for IPO
item.description: Kamarajar Port valuation discussions are still some time away, but the IPO is likely to be completed within calendar 2027

item.title: Crypto news: Bitcoin price falls to $64,962, lowest since July as investors favour AI stocks, factor likely Fed hike
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $65,000 on November 15, its lowest level since July, amid macroeconomic concerns, market liquidations and possible competition for investment from AI companies. The broader crypto market cap dropped to $2.19 trillion.

item.title: ₹10,000 cr Upcoming IPOs: Latest GMP price, key dates | Crystal Crop Protection, Mahanadi Coalfields, Watrana Rentals
item.description: India’s IPO calendar is set to accelerate from 16 November, with Crystal Crop Protection, Mahanadi Coalfields and Watrana Rentals bringing three issues to market. The offerings are expected to raise more than ₹10,000 crore combined, with investors watching issue details and grey market premiums.

item.title: MCX, BSE, Bharti Airtel shares: Top 3 stocks to buy; check expected returns, ratings, target price by market expert
item.description: Sensex fell 318.56 points to 81,592.45 and Nifty 50 dropped 155.05 points to 25,144.30 on Friday, ending a three-session rally as October retail inflation rose to 6.09%. Analyst Chandan Taparia recommended MCX, BSE and Bharti Airtel, while identifying key index support and resistance levels.

item.title: Top 3 stocks to buy: Redington, Aster DM, Canara Bank by Ganesh Dongre of Anand Rathi | Targets, stop-loss, market view
item.description: Nifty 50 prediction: The 25,500–25,600 zone will be the next significant resistance area to watch, says Ganesh Dongre of Anand Rathi

item.title: How to ensure that AI disruption doesn’t leave workers behind
item.description: Policymakers and business leaders have important roles to play in supporting U.S. citizens through the AI transition.

item.title: Best stocks to buy under ₹100: Lloyds Engineering, Niva Bupa, Vedanta Power by Sumeet Bagadia | Targets, stop-loss
item.description: Stock market prediction: Sumeet Bagadia of Choice Broking believes the bias for the Indian stock market is positive, until the Nifty 50 index is above 25,000

item.title: Bitcoin Tumbles to Three-Month Low as Liquidations Accelerate
item.description: Cryptocurrencies tumbled over the weekend, with Bitcoin slumping to a three-month low of just above $63,000 as leveraged long positions were liquidated.

item.title: Beyond Coal India, ONGC: 10 lesser-known dividend stocks with up to 19.6% yield - Premco, GOCL, Accelya to D-Link | List
item.description: Several lesser-known Indian stocks delivered high dividend yields in FY26. CyberTech Systems led the listed examples at 19.6%, followed by Majestic Auto at 16.4%, Jagran Prakashan at 16.1%, IL&amp;FS Investment Managers at 15.9%, and Premco Global at 11.2%.

item.title: Small-cap stock rallies 70% in a year: Motilal Oswal sees another 47% upside | Should you buy? Check target price
item.description: GNG Electronics shares rose 0.91% to ₹577.10 on Friday after early-week losses. Motilal Oswal maintained a Buy rating and ₹840 target, citing the company’s distribution scale, expanding network and demand for affordable refurbished computers.

item.title: Dividend king PSU stock: Down 23% in 6 months! Nuvama sees 42% upside; target price, rationale
item.description: NMDC shares fell 1.76% to ₹69.90 on Friday after its second-quarter EBITDA declined 3% year over year to ₹19.4 billion, below expectations. Nuvama retained a Buy rating and raised its target price to ₹100, citing normalized supplies and potential second-half volume growth.

item.title: NVIDIA shareholder Leo KoGuan backs Jensen Huang! Explains why he will not add more stake in flagship AI stock
item.description: Investor Leo KoGuan plans to reduce his Nvidia investment while continuing to support Jensen Huang, whom he hopes to back in a future superintelligence venture. KoGuan says Nvidia’s growth outlook remains strong and that AI is not a bubble.

item.title: Microsoft shares defy massive global outage, close higher on Friday; Outlook, Teams services recover - Things to know
item.description: Microsoft restored Outlook, Teams, Copilot and other Microsoft 365 services after a global outage lasting more than 24 hours and affecting users in over 70 countries. Microsoft ruled out a cyberattack; its shares closed nearly flat.

item.title: Tata Sons Listing: Noel Tata decodes why there should be no tinkering; what he said at Hindustan Times Leadership Summit
item.description: Noel Tata warned that listing Tata Sons could shift the group’s priorities toward shareholder returns and away from philanthropy. He said Tata Trusts would work with regulators and stakeholders to preserve conglomerate’s existing philosophy amid an ongoing dispute over its listing requirements.

item.title: Dividend stock to buy: TD Power shares rally 369% in 3 years, more upside ahead? Check target price before record date
item.description: TD Power Systems will be in focus ahead of its November 18 dividend record date. The board approved a dividend of ₹0.65 per share. Strong Q2 results, a robust order book and upgraded guidance have supported the stock, which SBI Securities rates Buy with a ₹732 target.

item.title: Upcoming dividend, stock split, buyback record date next week, 16-20 Nov: MRF, SCI, PFC, Power Grid, Venus Pipes, more
item.description: Investors will track several corporate actions next week, including BN Agrochem’s 10-for-1 stock split, InvIT income distributions, an amalgamation, rights issues and a share buyback. Record dates run from November 16 to November 20. The Nifty 50 and Sensex gained nearly 0.70%–1.30% for the week.

item.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: Coal India subsidiary files RHP - Latest GMP at ₹12.5; check key dates, size, valuation, more
item.description: Mahanadi Coalfields has filed its RHP for an IPO opening November 19, 2026. The offer is an offer for sale of up to 66.18 crore shares by Coal India, with no proceeds going to MCL. The company produced 218.31 million tonnes of coal in FY26.

item.title: 182% multibagger 1 yr return ! This Ice-cream maker announces bonus, stock split - Do you own? Ratio, record date detail
item.description: Sheetal Cool Products recommended a 5:1 bonus issue and a 1:2 stock split, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals. Record dates have not been announced. The stock closed 1.11% higher and had gained 11.39% over the previous week.

item.title: Up 325% in 4 years! Multibagger brewery stock with 1:10 stock split history declares Q2 Results 2026; revenue up 103%
item.description: Asgard Alcobev reported a 103% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 revenue to ₹48.93 crore and a more than 14-fold increase in net profit to ₹2.55 crore. The brewing company is targeting FY27 EBITDA of ₹24–28 crore and plans to expand annual capacity by about 29%.
